currentParagraphText: Turning to look at Jake, the god continued in his usual casual tone. “I’m tempted to lock you in a prison and have you perform experiments to see the extent of your abilities, but doing that would break the Bloodline Accords, piss off the Malefic Viper, make several other factions also start bothering me, and perhaps most importantly, not prove very effective.”
